scripts.dev:electron: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cd electron && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:electron
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:create: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --create-only
scripts.db:migrate:prod: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:status: cd server && npx prisma migrate status
scripts.db:migrate:baseline: cd server && npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 0_init
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
